title: ZenBoost
description: ZenBoost is a lightweight Minecraft optimization modpack designed to improve FPS, reduce lag spikes, speed up chunk loading, and deliver a smoother vanilla-friendly gameplay experience for both low-end and high-end PCs.
body:
# ZenFPS
### Silence the lag. Feel the performance.

ZenFPS is a lightweight Minecraft optimization modpack focused on delivering smoother gameplay, higher FPS, faster chunk loading, and reduced stuttering while keeping the vanilla experience clean and familiar.

Built for players who want maximum performance without unnecessary gameplay changes.

## Features
- Massive FPS improvements
- Faster chunk loading
- Reduced lag spikes and stutters 
- Better rendering optimization
- Improved memory usage
- Lightweight and stable
- Vanilla-friendly experience
- Multiplayer compatible
- Great for both low-end and high-end PCs

## Included Optimization Mods
- Sodium
- Lithium
- FerriteCore
- EntityCulling
- MoreCulling
- ImmediatelyFast
- ModernFix
- C2ME
- ServerCore
- Very Many Players


## Perfect For
PvP players
Survival worlds
Multiplayer servers
Low-end PCs
Smooth gameplay lovers


## Compatibility

Works great with Fabric and is compatible with Lunar Client in most setups.

### ZenFPS — Minimal lag. Maximum smoothness.
